title: Tax Invoice
key_sentences: The goods listed above were delivered on 9 October 2026 and signed for by your boathouse steward.
Please quote the invoice number on every remittance so that we can match your payment quickly.
We prefer payment by bank transfer to the account below.
Cheques are no longer accepted after the closure of our town-centre branch.

rows: Perfect-bound annual report 64 pp, 170 gsm silk cover
Saddle-stitched regatta programme 16 pp, two colours throughout
Colour proof Wet proof on the chosen stock
Delivery Pallet service to two addresses

list_items.text: 1) Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.
2) Late payments attract interest at 8% above the base rate, as permitted by statute.
a) A first reminder is sent seven days after the due date.
b) A fixed recovery charge of £70 applies to debts of £10,000 or more.
3) Title in the goods remains with Larkspur Print & Bindery Ltd. until the invoice is paid in full.

notes: Letterhead (organisation name and three address lines) is furniture, not a heading; the registration line is an @page bottom margin box. The 'Invoice to' and 'Deliver to' address boxes sit side by side and read box by box (left box, then right box), followed by the boxed key/value invoice panel to their right. Line-item table: rule under the header only, a rule above Subtotal, description cells of two lines (bold product name + spec) joined with one space; Subtotal/VAT/Total labels span four columns and are repeated in each covered cell. Payment-terms list: markers '1)' and 'a)' are TYPED in the text with a hanging indent (no CSS markers). Two key/value tables have no header row (the first row is data).
